scopeNotes: New text needs independent review; earlier hashes do not certify it.
Map endpoints are not historical founding or extinction dates.

The imported 1492 to 1500 polygon spans parts of present Nuevo León. It is not validated as a precise Alazapa homeland, political boundary, beginning or disappearance date. Later documented history is dated as later history.

Chichimeca, Coahuiltecan, Guachichil, Borrado, Tlaxcalteca and Alazapa are not interchangeable identities. No language affiliation, common kingship, population estimate or exclusive archaeological attribution is inferred.

The full 2024 visit edition and 2019 parish edition were downloaded. The pertinent original transcription pages were extracted and visually inspected. Santo Domingo is dated 22 February 1685. The adjacent Borrado testimonies are not assigned to Alazapas.

The Santo Domingo record uses Christóval. His wife is unnamed, and her wishes are not directly recorded. The card preserves that limitation and does not claim the governor’s order was enforced. No blanket claim of contentment is inferred from formulaic inspection language.

The 1653 parish entry and the editor’s nineteenth-century footnote are separate evidence. The book’s title does not turn Francisco into a Guachichil. The record alone does not establish how he reached Charcas.

The court exhibition was read through its indexed page because the live site returned an access error. Original case scans linked from that exhibition were not read. Marrufo’s complete UANL article was read; its historical author is Leonardo Marrufo Lara, distinct from the page’s posting account.

The 1711 division, 1823 authorization, 1826 ruling and later enforcement disputes are distinct events. The 1591 Tlaxcalteca migration is not used as a founding date for these towns. A water judgment is not evidence that compliance immediately followed.

Court and Marrufo sources are closely related archival accounts; combined derived prose is kept within a conservative shared source budget. Statements about agricultural harm remain attributed party claims.

The final historical phase is approximate and bounded by the evidence cited. It does not assert extinction in 1860 or 1861, present recognition of a specific organization, or transfer to a verified successor entity.
Independent historical review, geometry assessment and depth certification remain pending.
